card.name: Phosphate endings and dot leaders
card.fires_on: The end of salt names such as codeine phosphate, and the spaces or dotted leader lines that come before an amount in formulas and dosing tables.

modes.label: Phosphate salt names
modes.description: The word phosphate, or its ending, after a drug name like codeine.
modes.example: Promethazine HCl and Codeine Ph<<osphate>> Oral Solution may increase risk of urinary retention

modes.label: Dot leaders and gaps before amounts
modes.description: Rows of dots or a space after a name or abbreviation, just before a quantity in a table or formula.

modes.label: Space before a quantity in compatibility or formula lists
modes.description: A space after an ingredient or qs, right before a percent or volume.
modes.example: Vecuronium bromide is compatible in solution with: Sodium Chloride<< >>0.9% Injection Dextrose

card.plain: It marks the spot after a drug salt name or a row of dots where a dose or amount comes next.
